title: A Clearer Project Brief
subtitle: Editable structure, not a wall of text
meta: Illustrative example — no invented project metrics

blocks.text: Turn a shared outline into **readable, editable files**. Keep the detail in the document and the argument on the slides.
**Decision:** choose one audience and one central takeaway before formatting.

rows: Saved packages are checked for structural problems.
Actual pages are inspected for layout issues.

items: Add descriptive alt text to images.
Do not call an unrendered file visually verified.
